license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, or use the word "nurse" as a title for herself or himself, or use an abbreviation to indicate that the person is a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, unless the person is currently licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse as provided by this Article.

issuing_authority.quote: The North Carolina Board of Nursing shall conduct an election each year to fill vacancies of nurse members of the Board

name.quote: The North Carolina Board of Nursing shall conduct an election each year to fill vacancies of nurse members of the Board

type.quote: The Board shall consist of 14 members. Eight members shall be registered nurses. Three members shall be licensed practical nurses. Three members shall be representatives of the public.

degree_required.value: Graduated from a course of study approved by the Board
degree_required.quote: the applicant has graduated from a course of study approved by the Board and is mentally and physically competent to practice nursing

exams.name: NCLEX-RN/NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: The Board gives an examination at least twice each year. For multistate license applicants, NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN is explicitly required.
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN/R or NCLEX-PN/R Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable.

interval_years.quote: Every unencumbered license, except temporary license, issued under this Article shall be renewed for two years.

available.quote: The Board may, without examination, issue a license to an applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the laws of another state, territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or foreign country when that jurisdiction's requirements for licensure as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse, as the case may be, are substantially equivalent to or exceed those of the State of North Carolina

requirements.value: Applicant must be duly licensed in another jurisdiction with requirements substantially equivalent to or exceeding NC's; the Board may require proof of competence.
requirements.quote: The Board may, without examination, issue a license to an applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the laws of another state, territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or foreign country when that jurisdiction's requirements for licensure as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse, as the case may be, are substantially equivalent to or exceed those of the State of North Carolina at the time the applicant was initially licensed, and when, in the Board's opinion, the applicant is competent to practice nursing in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false information or withholding material information from the Board in procuring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has given false information or has withheld material information from the Board in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a crime indicating unfitness to practice nursing or deception of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to any crime which indicates that the nurse is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing or that the nurse has deceived or defrauded the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or physical or mental abnormality.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of material, or by reason of any physical or mental abnormality.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that endangers public health.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that endangers the public health.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by deliberate or negligent acts or omissions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of deliberate or negligent acts or omissions regardless of whether actual injury to the patient is established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that deceives, defrauds, or harms the public in professional activities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that deceives, defrauds, or harms the public in the course of professional activities or services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct nonconforming to standards of acceptable nursing practice or ethics, even without patient injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in unprofessional conduct that is nonconforming to the standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice or the ethics of the nursing profession, even if a patient is not injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acts of dishonesty, injustice, or immorality in or outside of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits acts of dishonesty, injustice, or immorality in the course of the licensee's practice or otherwise, including acts outside of this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or privilege to practice nursing denied, revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against by any jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license or privilege to practice nursing denied, revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against by any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond to the Board's inquiries in a reasonable manner or time.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to respond to the Board's inquiries in a reasonable manner or time regarding any matter affecting the license to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Article or rules adopted by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this Article or any provision of the rules adopted by the Board under this Article.

bonding_required.quote: Each nurses aide training program ... shall provide a guaranty bond unless the program has already provided a bond or an alternative to a bond under G.S. 115D-95.

definition_quote.value: Nursing is a dynamic discipline which includes the assessing, caring, counseling, teaching, referring and implementing of prescribed treatment in the maintenance of health, prevention and management of illness, injury, disability or the achievement of a dignified death.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" is a dynamic discipline which includes the assessing, caring, counseling, teaching, referring and implementing of prescribed treatment in the maintenance of health, prevention and management of illness, injury, disability or the achievement of a dignified death.

methods_authorized.quote: The "practice of nursing by a registered nurse" consists of the following 10 components: Assessing the patient's physical and mental health, including the patient's reaction to illnesses and treatment regimens ... Implementing the treatment and pharmaceutical regimen prescribed by any person authorized by State law to prescribe the regimen.

drug_authority.value: RNs may implement the treatment and pharmaceutical regimen prescribed by any person authorized by State law to prescribe the regimen; subject to G.S. 90-18.2, RNs may not prescribe a medical treatment regimen or make a medical diagnosis except under supervision of a licensed physician.
drug_authority.quote: Implementing the treatment and pharmaceutical regimen prescribed by any person authorized by State law to prescribe the regimen.

aprn_role_categories.quote: one shall be an individual who meets the requirements to practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist, a certified nurse midwife, a clinical nurse specialist, or a nurse practitioner

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: performing tasks assigned or delegated by and performed under the supervision or under orders or directions of a registered nurse, physician licensed to practice medicine, dentist, or other person authorized by State law to provide the supervision.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The Board of Nursing, established pursuant to G.S. 90-171.21, shall establish a Nurses Aides Registry for persons functioning as nurses aides regardless of title.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: The Board of Nursing shall do the following: Establish standards for faculty and applicant requirements for medication aide training.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: The delegation to any person, including a member of the patient's family, by a physician licensed to practice medicine in North Carolina, a licensed dentist or registered nurse of those patient-care services which are routine, repetitive, limited in scope that do not require the professional judgment of a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Before hiring a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse in North Carolina, a health care facility shall verify that the applicant has a current, valid license to practice nursing pursuant to G.S. 90-171.43.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The party states hereby create and establish a joint public entity known as the Interstate Commission of Nurse Licensure Compact Administrators.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or as a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN), under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: Establish programs for monitoring the treatment, recovery, and safe practice of nurses with substance use disorders, mental health disorders, or physical conditions impacting the ability to deliver safe care.
